//: Type-CHECKING only -- this project has no build step. Node 26 runs .ts files
natively by stripping types, so `node src/bot/index.ts` is the real entry
point and tsc never emits. See docs/decisions.md ADR-004.
allowImportingTsExtensions -- Node requires explicit .ts on relative
imports; './x.js' and './x' both fail at runtime.
Node cannot strip. Without this the type-checker would happily accept
code that throws the moment it runs.
